latest_release.name: v3.8.0
latest_release.body:
### Breaking Changes / Upgrade Notes

- **Metrics move off the agent-facing proxy port.** `/metrics` and `/stats` are available only when `metrics_listen` names a dedicated listener. Omitted, null, or blank values expose neither route at startup. Managed containment rejects a reload that removes or blanks the setting. The existing listener stays bound, `/metrics` returns `403` until a valid reload clears the denial, and `/stats` keeps serving loopback clients. Restart to disable the listener. Update scraper targets and keep agents off the unauthenticated metrics listener with network controls. Changing the address requires restart. [Upgrade guide](docs/guides/upgrading-to-3.8.md). ([#2044](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/2044))
- **New container and chart releases use `ghcr.io/pipelab-org`.** Update image repositories, registry policies and Helm OCI URLs when adopting this release. Releases through v3.7.1 retain their original registry addresses. v3.7.1 attestations use `pipelab-org/pipelock`; releases through v3.7.0 retain the `luckyPipewrench/pipelock` signing identity. Generated Compose and sidecar output also adopt the new image defaults. The Go module path and Homebrew tap stay unchanged. [Verified installation](README.md#verify-release-integrity). ([#1911](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/1911), [#2020](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/2020), [#2062](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/2062))
- **Expired temporary scanner exceptions lapse instead of preventing startup.** A valid expired entry emits a startup or reload warning and ordinary scanning resumes for its scope. Malformed entries still reject configuration. Running scanners enforce expiry without waiting for reload; there's no separate clock-triggered warning. ([#1942](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/1942))
- **Non-finite floating-point settings are rejected.** Replace NaN or infinity values with finite values inside the setting's supported range before upgrading. The configuration error names the affected field. ([#2029](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/2029))
- **The default URL ceiling increases to 8000 octets.** Explicit limits still win, and presets with tighter limits retain them. Operators who require the previous ceiling should set `fetch_proxy.monitoring.max_url_length` explicitly. Longer URLs can carry more data per request; the other URL checks still apply. ([#2052](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/2052))
- **Generated audit configurations retain explicit tool-policy blocks and disable adaptive escalation.** Ordinary findings remain warnings. Regenerated strict configurations also retain their bundled actions, taint policy and tool-chain detection. Review regenerated policy before replacing a custom configuration. ([#1943](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/1943), [#1961](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/1961))
- **Regenerated agent presets and the quickstart retain built-in and supplemental response patterns.** The `claude-code`, `cursor`, `generic-agent`, and `hostile-model` presets give supplemental expressions `Preset` names. Review name-based alerts and suppressions when replacing older YAML; existing saved configurations keep their names until edited or replaced. [Preset migration](docs/configuration.md#presets). ([#2063](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/2063), [#2066](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/2066))
- **Core findings remain visible in repository scans.** `git scan-diff`, `audit`, and the GitHub Action apply the core DLP floor even with custom patterns or defaults disabled. Inline markers and rule suppressions can't silence core findings; path exclusions still exclude the entire path. Review synthetic fixtures and narrowly scoped exclusions before upgrading. [Suppression guide](docs/guides/suppression.md). ([#2064](https://github.com/pipelab-org/pipelock/pull/2064))
